name: Stuxnet
description: Autumn Rivers' all-in-one extension mod: RadioV3, SMS, quests, cutscenes, vaults, BYOD daemons, persistence and more.

stuxnet.anim.label: animation element
stuxnet.anim.source: an element ID in this file

templates.label: Stuxnet cutscene
templates.body:
<StuxnetCutscene>
  <Elements>
    <Rectangle ID="bg" Position="0,0" Size="1,1" Color="0,0,0" />
    <Text ID="title" Position="0.1,0.45" Size="0.8,0.1" StartingValue="" FontScale="1.5" Color="255,255,255" />
  </Elements>
  <Instructions>
    <Fade ElementID="bg" Duration="1" Delay="0" FadeIn="true" />
    <Typewriter ElementID="title" Duration="2" Delay="1" Text="{{id}}" />
    <DelayEnd Delay="5" />
  </Instructions>
</StuxnetCutscene>

templates.label: Stuxnet animated theme
templates.body:
<StuxnetAnimatedTheme>
  <BaseTheme>Themes/ExampleTheme.xml</BaseTheme>
  <Elements>
    <GridFX ID="grid" Position="0,0" Size="1,1" Color="40,80,120" />
  </Elements>
  <Instructions>
    <ToggleVisibility ElementID="grid" Duration="0" Delay="0" Visible="true" />
  </Instructions>
</StuxnetAnimatedTheme>
